cards.title: Paperclip Plaza Parcel Day Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: fold a beginning clue into the ending return
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder story-arc card for shaping one private fictional Paperclip Plaza parcel story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out the card, one blank page, and three folder pocket labels for beginning, middle change, and ending return: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: make up a parcel helper, a plaza parcel, and a clue tag that can come back at the end: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: write who finds the paperclip-handled parcel and what tiny symbol is on its tag: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: show how the same symbol appears on two plaza counters but means a different job at each one: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: choose whether the helper opens the parcel at the table or follows the best symbol match on paper: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write what changes in the plaza because of that choice, such as a clearer key, calmer parcel cart, or sorted notes: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the first tag symbol and show how it finally points to the right parcel place: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: tuck one parcel tag note into the accordion folder pocket that matches its story arc job: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult names the parcel tag, and the writer fills only the beginning and ending return blanks: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: continue a paper-only plaza story by carrying one parcel clue from beginning to ending return: ____________________.

cards.title: Penny Path Compass Shop Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: sort arc notes into beginning, middle, and ending pockets
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder story-arc card for a private fictional Penny Path compass shop story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place the accordion folder beside a blank compass note and point to the beginning, middle, and ending pockets: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent a button compass, a folded errand slip, and one helper choice that changes the path of the story: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: write how the helper borrows the button compass and what the folded slip asks them to find: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: make the compass needle point toward a kinder next step instead of the expected direction: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: choose whether the helper trusts the moving needle or writes a new paper map of each kind turn: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write what changes after the choice, such as a steadier compass note, a clearer path card, or a thankful mailbox row: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the folded slip and show how its first errand is answered in the final sentence: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: sort one compass clue into the folder pocket where it belongs in the story arc: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to the compass note, and the writer adds only one middle change sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: build another paper-only compass shop story by saving one beginning slip and one ending return note: ____________________.

cards.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Lab Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: carry one tidepool question through the middle
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder story-arc card for a private fictional tidepool timekeepers lab story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out a blank tide note, the accordion folder, and one pencil mark for the beginning clue pocket: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: create a tidepool helper, a lab work spot, and a tide question that changes but stays connected: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: write the first tide question the helper notices beside the shell-shadow jars: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: show one tide mark, pebble note, or seaweed flag that does not match the helper's first guess: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: choose whether the helper checks the pebble notebook, compares two shell shadows, or moves one note to a new pocket: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write how the helper's choice changes the lab plan without leaving the pretend tidepool work spot: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the first tide question and answer it with one calm detail from the middle change: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: place one tidepool clue in the accordion folder pocket that shows where the story arc has moved: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult reads the tide question, and the writer writes only the ending return sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep a paper-only tidepool lab arc steady by carrying one question from beginning to ending: ____________________.

cards.title: Rain Gauge Railway Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: use a paper gauge note to show what changed
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder story-arc card for a private fictional rain gauge railway story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out the accordion folder, one blank gauge note, and a paper rail card for story-arc sorting: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent a small railway helper, a rain gauge note, and one track change that moves the story forward: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: write what the helper sees on the rain gauge ticket before the tiny railway starts its paper trip: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: show how a track switch sends the sample car toward the wrong rail card or weather post: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: choose whether the helper checks the gauge again, redraws the track plan, or writes a careful rail note: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write what changes because of the choice, such as a corrected sample car, calmer weather flags, or a clearer gauge mark: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the first rain gauge ticket and show how the final rail note explains it: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: tuck the gauge note into the folder pocket that names its beginning, middle, or ending job: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult circles the gauge ticket, and the writer fills only the choice bridge blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: continue a paper-only railway arc by saving one gauge note and returning to it at the end: ____________________.

cards.title: Compost Clock Workshop Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: turn one compost-clock mix-up into a calm ending
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder story-arc card for a private fictional compost clock workshop story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place the accordion folder beside a blank layer dial note and choose one beginning pocket for the workshop clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: make up a workshop helper, a leaf-layer clock, and one slow change that can return at the ending: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: write the first clock mix-up, such as a leaf layer appearing on the wrong dial mark: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: show how a worm tunnel map, soil jar, or layer flag reveals that the clock is reading the stack in a new order: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: choose whether the helper rebuilds the layer dial, labels a new pocket, or asks the workshop map to explain the order: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write how the workshop changes after that choice, such as a steadier dial, clearer layer note, or calmer soil shelf: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the first clock mix-up and show how it now makes sense in the final workshop note: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: file one compost-clock clue in the accordion folder pocket that shows its place in the arc: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult names the layer dial, and the writer writes only one middle change detail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep a paper-only compost-clock arc by returning one beginning mix-up as the ending answer: ____________________.
